title: Chapter 1: The Shattered Realm
paragraphs: The morning mist settled heavy across the valley, concealing the jagged peaks of the Black Frost Mountain range.

Arthur stood at the edge of the cliff, listening to the subtle reverberation of spiritual energy pulsing beneath the stone. For three years, he had been regarded as a talentless outer disciple of the Azure Lotus Sect.
However, nobody knew that deep inside his soul lay the Void Prism—a celestial treasure from a forgotten era.

As he breathed in the cool mountain air, the prism hummed softly in his chest. A subtle tear appeared in the fabric of space directly in front of him, opening a doorway to a dimension untouched by living mortals.
